name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on one knee on the floor with your opposite foot planted flat in front of you so both knees are bent near 90 degrees.
Lift your chest, gently tuck your pelvis and tighten the glute on the kneeling side.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a clear stretch along the front of your kneeling hip and thigh.
Hold the stretch steadily while breathing slowly on one side, then release and switch legs.
tips: Keep your ribs down and avoid overarching your lower back to chase more forward movement.
Squeezing your rear glute deepens the hip flexor stretch without needing a large lean.
